# Swara Travels

> Mumbai-based outstation cab and taxi service offering fixed-rate, no-surge AC cab bookings across Maharashtra — Mumbai, Pune, Nashik, Solapur, Ashtavinayak Yatra, and Shirdi. Positioned as a reliable, fixed-price alternative to Uber/Ola for outstation and pilgrimage travel.

Swara Travels operates from Aarey Colony, Goregaon East, Mumbai 400065. Bookings are taken 24/7 via WhatsApp with a fixed fare quoted before the trip starts (no surge pricing, even during festivals like Ganesh Chaturthi and Ashadhi Ekadashi). The same driver stays with the customer for the entire multi-day trip and is familiar with temple/pilgrimage routes and timings.

## Key facts
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 8104050420
- Email: swaratravels4453@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/swaratravels4453/
- Base location: Aarey Colony, Goregaon East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400065
- Service area: Mumbai, Pune, Nashik, Solapur, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Shirdi, Pandharpur, and the Ashtavinayak temple circuit
- Fleet: Swift Dzire / Hyundai Xcent (4-seater sedan), WagonR (4-seater budget), Ertiga / Kia Carens (6-seater), Chevrolet Enjoy (6-seater)
- Indicative pricing: Sedan ₹12–14/km, 6-seater SUV ₹16–18/km — fixed fare, no surge, decided before the trip
- Track record: 500+ trips completed, 5-star average customer rating
- Availability: 24/7, including high-demand pilgrimage seasons (Ashadhi Ekadashi, Kartiki Ekadashi, Ganesh Chaturthi, Navratri)
- Booking method: WhatsApp (no app required)

## Tour packages
- Ashtavinayak Yatra: 2-day, 654 km circuit covering all 8 Ashtavinayak Ganesh temples (Morgaon, Siddhatek, Pali, Mahad, Theur, Lenyadri, Ozar, Ranjangaon), starting and ending at Morgaon
- Nashik Tour: Mumbai↔Nashik (~165–170 km, ~3.5 hrs), covering Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga, Panchvati, Saptashrungi Devi, Kalaram Temple, Sula Vineyards, Pandavleni Caves; combinable with a Shirdi Sai Baba visit
- Solapur / Pandharpur Tour: Mumbai↔Pandharpur (~330–340 km), covering Vitthal-Rukmini Temple (Pandharpur), Swami Samarth Temple (Akkalkot), Tulja Bhavani Shakti Peeth (Tuljapur), and Siddharameshwar Temple (Solapur)
